## The browser has no `require` of your files

A page can load one script URL. `require("./walker.js")` is a Node idea. A **bundler** walks your `import` graph and emits files the browser can load.

This lesson does not run a bundler. It asks you to name the problem.

blocks.promptMd: Why do front-end apps use a bundler (or native ESM URLs)?

choices.md: The browser does not `require()` a folder of files the way Node does

blocks.explainMd: You can also ship native ESM with import maps. The gap is still: the browser is not Node’s module loader.
